name: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana
benefit: **Scholarship Amount:** - Girl students from classes 6 to 12 are provided ₹251/0 per month, at the rate of ₹3,012/- annually.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a girl student of any category. 1. The girl student must be studying from class 6 to class 12 in a Sanskrit school of Uttarakhand. 1. A total of 175 enrolled girl students will be eligible.
